svg.aria-label: Jason Nikas. I build systems from code down to hardware: GPUs on FPGAs, CUDA programs, filesystems and distributed runtimes. Currently working on GPGPU v2, the next step for our RISC-V GPGPU (DDR memory and 720p60 graphics done; divergence and warp scheduling in progress), and a homelab that hosts the FPGA lab.
